units.rawText: Professor? So you were here, too... The weather's great, isn't it? I didn't expect the Oasis to actually have a weather simulation system; that's a really decadent use of operands!

units.rawText: You see, whenever I went out on assignments in the real world, the weather was always bad... There were storms, mudslides, smoke, and just about everything that happened during that bad weather was annoying.

units.rawText: That's why I have a soft spot for clear blue skies. You know, I have to say... the fact that you can manage the Oasis and keep it from becoming crowded and messy means you really are an amazing person.
